Authentication

The API works on your own services only. All requests use HTTPS and all replies are JSON.

Personal token

Create a token in My Account, Security. Send your username and the token as HTTP Basic authentication. A token has one access level: read only, or read and actions. A token is shown once and can be revoked at any time.

OAuth for apps

An app that acts for a customer uses OAuth 2.1 with the authorization code flow and PKCE (S256). Apps register themselves (RFC 7591). The customer chooses the access level when connecting. The addresses are in the OpenAPI document.

OpenAPI 3.1 document (openapi.json)

Base address
https://example.org/wp-json/x
Request with a personal token
curl -u "USERNAME:TOKEN" https://example.org/wp-json/x/resources
Request with an OAuth access token
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ACCESS_TOKEN" https://example.org/wp-json/x/resources

Passwords, console access, transfer codes and actions that destroy something, such as reinstall, restore and delete, are not part of the API. They are only available in the dashboard. Every change made with a token is written to the history of the service.

Errors and limits

An error has an HTTP status and a JSON body with a code and a message, and the status again inside data.

StatusMeaning
401Not signed in.
429Too many requests & more.

Rate limit: 60 requests a minute for each token. Some requests have lower limits of their own. A reply of 429 means wait a minute and try again.

Error reply
{"code":"rest_forbidden","message":"...","data":{"status":403}}

Use with Claude (MCP)

Claude can work with your services through an MCP connector. You choose what Claude may do when you connect, and you can disconnect it in My Account, Security at any time.

Set up

  1. In Claude, open Settings, then Connectors, then Add custom connector.
  2. Paste the connector address.
  3. Claude opens this site. Sign in if you are asked to.
  4. Choose an access level and confirm.

Read and Actions access never show passwords and cannot restore, roll back, reinstall, delete or cancel. Full access can do those things, order a server or a database and show a password once, but only after Claude has shown you a summary and you have said yes in the chat. A password shown this way stays in the conversation. Domain transfers, transfer codes and the console are never possible through Claude, only in your dashboard. Every request Claude makes is written to the history of the service.

Connector address
https://example.org/mcp
